title: Groundhog: reliability of tool-using agents on medical-evidence tasks (v1.1.0)
description: Benchmark of 50 verified medical-evidence tasks for tool-using AI agents, with frozen tool responses, fault injection, scorers (outcome, process, pass^k), a calibrated model judge, a failure taxonomy and an item analysis. v1.1.0 adds Gemini 3.1 Pro (preview), a tool-budget sweep, and the untraced-citation rule. Code MIT; task files CC BY 4.0.
